2608.13389.title: TopoIntent: Compiling Security Intent into Executable, Compliance-Checked Network Topologies
2608.13389.paper_summary: Enterprise security topology design requires translating business intent, regulatory requirements, and risk assumptions into zones, boundary devices, inter-zone paths, and access-control policies. Existing NetOps automation tools mainly operate after this design is fixed, providing limited support for generating structured security topologies from underspecified natural-language requirements. We present TopoIntent, a system that compiles security intent into executable, compliance-checked network topologies. It uses a schema contract to constrain generation, retrieves reference architectures from a curated template library via dense-vector search, and applies staged fusion for intent-template alignment and security completion. The generated topology is checked against CIS Controls v8.1.2 safeguards visible at the topology layer, while unresolved cases are marked for manual review. Structural gaps are repaired through additive schema-preserving edits. The final topology is exported to Mininet scripts with kernel-level iptables ACLs, enabling executable reachability and allow/deny tests. Because no public benchmark exists for this requirement-to-topology task, we construct an evaluation set from reference security architecture diagrams. The retrieval set contains 22 templates and 44 synthetic intents across five scenarios, while the held-out set contains 7 templates and 14 intents from finance and government scenarios excluded from retrieval. On the held-out set, additive repair improves topology-visible CIS satisfaction from 0.78 to 1.00 in fewer than 1.5 rounds on average, and one feedback round raises the post-ACL policy pass rate from 0.78 to 0.88.
2608.13389.paper_summary_zh: 企業安全拓撲設計需要將商業意圖、法規要求和風險假設轉換為區域、邊界設備、區域間路徑和訪問控制政策。現有的 NetOps 自動化工具主要在此設計固定後運行，對從不明確的自然語言需求生成結構化安全拓撲的支持有限。我們提出了 TopoIntent，一個將安全意圖編譯為可執行、合規檢查的網絡拓撲的系統。它使用模式合約來限制生成，通過密集向量搜索從策劃的模板庫中檢索參考架構，並應用分階段融合進行意圖模板對齊和安全完成。生成的拓撲會根據拓撲層可見的 CIS Controls v8.1.2 安全措施進行檢查，而未解決的案例則標記為手動審查。結構性缺口通過附加的保留模式編輯進行修復。最終拓撲被導出到 Mininet 腳本中，並配有內核級的 iptables ACL，實現可執行的可達性和允許/拒絕測試。由於沒有公共基準可用於此需求到拓撲的任務，我們從參考安全架構圖構建了一個評估集。檢索集包含 22 個模板和 44 個合成意圖，涵蓋五個場景，而保留集則包含 7 個模板和 14 個來自金融和政府場景的意圖，這些場景被排除在檢索之外。在保留集上，附加修復將拓撲可見的 CIS 滿意度從 0.78 提高到 1.00，平均少於 1.5 輪，而一次反饋輪次將後 ACL 政策通過率從 0.78 提高到 0.88。
